caption: The drawing depicts a single, high-backed armchair with winged sides and upholstered seat, back, and arms. The upholstery is predominantly red with an ornate, textured floral or damask pattern throughout, rendered in varying shades of red and pink, with hints of gold or beige accents in the fabric pattern. The chair features a wooden frame visible at the legs, which are carved in a cabriole style with detailed claw-and-ball feet. The wood is dark brown in color. The entire chair is centered on a plain, beige background, bordered by a simple, thin rectangular outline. The depiction is realistic and detailed, showing textures and shadows that give depth to the upholstery and woodwork.
title: Wing Chair
